WHERE c.content_type = 'SAFETY_EDU'
AND c.visible_yn = CASE WHEN #{isPublic} = 'visible' THEN 'Y' WHEN #{isPublic} = 'hidden' THEN 'N' ELSE c.visible_yn END
AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND c.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
/* 리스트 조회 (사용자 이름 포함) */ SELECT c.*, u.user_name FROM content c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY c.ordering ASC, c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
/* 조회수 카운트 */ SELECT count(*) FROM content c
/* 상세 조회 (사용자 이름 포함) */ SELECT c.*, u.user_name FROM content c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId}
mapper.update: /* 안전교육 수정 */ UPDATE content SET title = #{title}, visible_yn = #{visibleYn}, body = #{body}, content_link = #{contentLink}, ordering = #{ordering}, last_update_date = NOW() WHERE content_id = #{contentId}
mapper.delete: /* 안전교육 단건 삭제 */ DELETE FROM content WHERE content_id = #{contentId}
